dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: If you ask me, you really lose out by being the host! Sure, you get the best seat in the house, but do you think I want to be just watching?

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: I want to get in the ring too, and go head-to-head with the best opponents!

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: Though when I say it like that, it does seem to lack a bit of theatricality, which hand-to-hand combat only has so much of in the first place. I'll have to come up with some other limitations...
